'''Keldabe Air Traffic Control''' or '''Keldabe ATC''', was the service responsible for monitoring and directing [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Realspace/Legends|airspace]]. Headquartered in [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]],<ref name="Revelation" /> Keldabe Air Traffic Control possessed standard operating procedures that dictated they monitor all non-Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|starships]] on the ground for signs of trouble.<ref name="APM" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Keldabe Air Traffic Control contacted the reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] upon his approach to Keldabe, notifying Fett that his contact [[Nom Anor|Udelen]] was waiting for him at the [[Keldabe spaceport|city spaceport]] and his ship was under observation.<ref name="APM">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref>

When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] journeyed to [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]] in [[41 ABY]], [[Gender/Legends|she]] contacted Keldabe Air Traffic Control requesting permission to land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Mandalore. Keldabe ATC welcomed Solo, and assigned the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] a personal escort in the form of a [[Tra'kad-class transport|''Tra'kad''-class transport]]. With instructions from Keldabe ATC, Solo followed her ''Tra'kad'' escort down to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] where she touched down safely.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
Keldabe Air Traffic Control was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[2006]] [[EBook|e-novella]] ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]]. Traviss' later ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', published [[February 26]], [[2008]], featured Keldabe ATC again.
